title: Wish / if only
note: wish + past / past perfect / would; if only · first draft night/2026-08-06

items.en: I wish I had more time.
accepts: I wish I had more time.
items.explanation: wish + past for present unreal situation.
items.explanation_cz: wish + past pro přítomnou nerealitu.

items.en: She wishes she had studied medicine.
accepts: She wishes she had studied medicine.
items.explanation: wish + past perfect for past regret.
items.explanation_cz: wish + past perfect pro minulou lítost.

items.en: If only it would stop raining.

items.explanation: if only + would for a desired change (often annoying situation).
items.explanation_cz: if only + would pro žádanou změnu.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: **Wish** and **if only** talk about things you want to be different — now, in the past, or about someone's behaviour.
points: Present unreal: wish + past (or were / could)
If only is stronger / more emotional

cards.title: Form (short)
points: I wish I lived… / I wish I were… / I wish I could…
I wish I had + past participle…
I wish you would… / If only it would…

cards.title: When to use which
points: You dislike your present situation → past form after wish
You regret a past action → past perfect after wish
You want someone to stop / start doing something → would
Do not use wish + will for future plans (use hope)

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: wish + present: I wish I have… (wrong)
wish + would for your own ability (use could)
wish + past simple for past regret (use past perfect)
if only + will instead of would

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: Is it about now, the past, or someone's behaviour?
